> As a visitor, do not press back or refresh on a page you reached by submitting a form.

Navigate to it through a link instead. As a developer, this is your fix to make: respond to a successful POST with a 303 redirect to a normal GET URL, which is the POST-redirect-GET pattern. Then the back button lands on a cacheable GET page and the prompt disappears permanently.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/err-cache-miss/
